author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The exported transform helper has no production caller and duplicates the existing Reader HTML issuer boundary.
findings.consequence: The extra API makes the renderable HTML authority surface larger than needed, and future code can use a generic string transform to re-mint Reader-managed HTML without adding a domain-specific policy at the actual transformation site.
findings.evidence: Line 82 exports transformManagedReaderHtml, but repository reference inspection found only test/contract references to this function; the production Reader search-highlighting path uses issueManagedReaderHtml directly in app/lib/search-hit-highlight.ts, and the Reader API issues the original page HTML with issueManagedReaderHtml in server/api/reader/[author]/[title]/[page]/[mediatype].get.ts.
findings.recommendation: Delete transformManagedReaderHtml and keep transformations at their domain-specific call sites using issueManagedReaderHtml after the local policy has validated or intentionally preserved the managed Reader HTML authority.
